
//INSERTING AN EVENT
"insert $new-event isa event; $new-event has name node.name; $new-event has output node.output;"

// INSERTING A CAUSAL PATH
"match"
"$node.source isa event, has name node.source.name;"
"$node.target isa event, has name node.target.name;"
"insert"
"$causal_path (cause: $node.source, effect: $node.target) isa causal_path;"






//METHOD 1
Using the point of view that a causal model contains a list of causal paths and a list of instances

//INSERTING A SUBMODEL INSTANCE INTO A LIST OF A CAUSAL MODEL
"match"
"$main_model_type  isa event, has name main_model_type.name;"
"$submodel_instance isa event, has name submodel.name;"
"$causal_model (main: $main_model_type) isa causal_model, has name main_model_type.name"
"insert"
"$causal_model(subflow: $submodel_instance)

// INSERTING A CAUSAL PATH INTO A LIST OF A CAUSAL MODEL
"match"
"$cause isa event, has name node.source.name;"
"$effect isa event, has name node.target.name;"
"$causal_path ($cause, $effect) isa causal_path;"
"$main_model_type  isa event, has name main_model_type.name;"
"$causal_model (main: $main_model_type) isa causal_model, has name main_model_type.name;"
"insert"
"$causal_model (contains: $causal_path);"





//METHOD 2

match
$submodel_instance isa event, has name submodel_instance.name;
$submodel_event isa event, has name submodel_event.name;
insert $causal_model (subflow: $submodel_instance, contains: $submodel_event) isa causal_model
$causal_model has name sub_instance.main_type




// UPDATED METHOD 2
match
$submodel_instance isa event, has name submodel_instance.name;
$submodel_event isa event, has name submodel_event.name;
$submodel_event_2 isa event, has name submodel_event_2.name;
$causal_path ($submodel_event, $submodel_event_2) isa causal_path;
insert $causal_model (subflow: submodel_instance, contains:causal_path) isa causal_model,
$causal_model has name sub_instance.main_type
